args.name: settings-toggle
args.description: Opens a Network & internet sub-page and puts its switch into a state. args: label (the row to open), on (boolean).
args.script:
phone.open("Settings")
phone.wait(2500)
phone.tap(phone.waitFor({ text = "Network & internet" }, 8000))
phone.wait(2500)
phone.tap(phone.waitFor({ text = args.label }, 8000))
phone.wait(2500)

local q = { id = "switch_widget" }
local t = phone.waitFor(q, 8000)
if not t then phone.log("NO-TOGGLE") return "none" end
phone.log("found=" .. args.label .. " checked=" .. tostring(t.checked))

local _, why = phone.ensure(q, args.on)
phone.log("ensure(" .. tostring(args.on) .. ")=" .. why)
return "called-with-" .. args.label
